result:
The March US AP and expense review is complete and the memo has been submitted. Summary of what I found and did:

**Corrections posted**
- **Duplicate AP entry — Stackline STA-98877 ($31,148.20):** Invoice DOC-0160 was booked twice (JE-00232 and JE-00241) but paid only once. Posted reversal JE-00307 with support attached and routed it for your approval since it exceeds the $10,000 threshold.
- **Miscoding — Northgate NDC-7719 ($3,880):** A data-center colocation invoice was memo'd "team dinner" and charged to Meals & Entertainment. Posted JE-00308 reclassifying it to Hosting & Infrastructure (under threshold, support DOC-0172 attached).

**Exceptions escalated**
- **EXC-001 — "Legal retainer" $6,750 (JE-00288):** Manual entry with no support. Bank confirms a wire to an account ending 7731, but there's no invoice, engagement letter, or authorization anywhere in the document store. Left in place; needs payee identification and support before it can be validated or reclassified.
- **EXC-002 — Zoom card charges:** Five $149.90 charges in March including two on 3/08. All are on the bank statement so the ledger isn't duplicated, but the frequency suggests a vendor-side double charge or extra subscriptions worth disputing/confirming.

**Verified clean:** Lumen, Quire, Tessellate, Con Edison, Oakridge, and all other card charges — booked once, coded correctly, consistent with prior months. Cutoff is clean: all March bills recorded, nothing from April slipped in, no recurring vendors missing.

**Checklist:** "AP cutoff review" set to in_progress pending your approval of JE-00307 and resolution of the retainer exception. One note for the bank rec: the $65 March service charge isn't in the ledger yet.
